# RHS-IA contribution guidance

See the repository [contribution guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md), [coding instructions](copilot-instructions.md), and [customization ledger](../docs/upgrades/rhs-customizations.md). Open RHS-IA-specific issues and pull requests in this repository. Preserve Positron, Code OSS, and third-party notices. No Posit contributor license agreement is asserted for contributions to this fork.
